description: Image Description: The image depicts a modern living room with large windows that allow natural light to illuminate the space. There is a black L-shaped leather sofa with zebra-patterned throw pillows positioned on a green area rug. In front of the sofa is a dark coffee table with a decorative bowl on top. The room features wooden floors and white walls. A sleek, contemporary light fixture hangs from the ceiling above the seating area. Radiators are visible beneath the windows, and there is a piece of framed artwork
